spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (अर्कयति)
1 To praise.
2 To heat or warm.

m. (-र्कः)
1 The sun.
2

Crystal.
3

Swallow wort, (Calotropis gigantea.)
4

Copper.
5
A name of

INDRA.
6

A Paṇḍita or learned man.
7 An elder brother.
8 Sunday.
E.
अर्च to worship or respect, क Uṇādi affix, and the च is dropped; what is worshipped or respected: or अर्क to heat, affix अच्.

du. m. (-जौ)
The two sons of SŪRYA and AŚVINĪ, and physicians of Svarga.
E.
अर्क the sun, and ज who is born.

m. (-यः)
The son of SŪRYA or the sun, applicable to YAMA, to SANI, to the Munis VAIVASVATA and SĀVARṆI, to REVANTA, and to KARṆA.
f. (-या)
The daughter of the sun, applied to the river goddesses YAMUNĀ and TAPATĪ.
E.
अर्क, and तनय a son.

f. (-त्विट्)
1 A ray of light.
2 The light of the sun.
E.
अर्क, and त्विष् radiance.

n. (-नं)
A solar day.
E.
अर्क, and दिन a day: also अर्कदिवसं, &c.

m. (-नः)
YAMA, &c. see अर्कतनय.
E.
as before, and नन्दन a son.

m. (-त्रः)
Swallow wort, (Calotropis gigantea.)
f. (-त्रा)
A kind of birth wort, (Aristolochia Indica.)
E.
अर्क the swallow wort, and पत्र a leaf: the leaves of the two plants being similar.

m. (-र्णः)
Swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea, or Calotropis.)
E.
अर्क the sun, and पर्ण a leaf.

m. (-पः)
The Nimb tree, (Nimba or Melia azadirachta.)
E.
अर्क, and पादप a tree.

f. (-का)
A plant, vulgarly Arkahuli, (Cleome pentaphylla). Also अर्कपुष्पी.

m. (-न्धुः)
A name of BUDDHA, the founder of the BAUDDHA sect of Hindus.
E.
अर्क the sun, and बन्धु a kinsman, being of the Sūrya Van's, or line of the sun.

m. (-वः)
See the preceding.
E.
as before, बान्धव a kinsman.

n. (-लं)
The disc of the sun.
E.
अर्क, and मण्डल a circle.

f. (-ला)
Birthwort. See अर्कपत्रा.

m. (-जः)
REVANTA the son of SŪRYA.
E.
अर्क, रेतस् the semen, and ज born.

m. (-षः)
A solar year.
E.
अर्क, and वर्ष a year; also अर्कवत्सर, &c.

n. (-तं)
1 Levying taxes, subjecting the people to heavy imposts, drawing their wealth as the sun evaporizes water.
2 Periodical worship of the sun.
E.
अर्क the sun, and व्रत observance.

m. (-नुः)
YAMA, regent of the dead.
E.
अर्क, and सूनु a son: the son of SŪRYA. See अर्कतनय.

m. (-रः)
The elephant of INDRA.
E.
अर्क, सोदर kinsman, from स with, and उदर womb; from their being alike engaged in maintaining the universe.

m. (-शः)
A digit or twelfth of the sun's disc.
E.
अर्क, and अंश a part.

m. (-श्मा)
1 A crystal lens. See सूर्य्यकान्त.
2 A ruby.
E.
अर्क, and अश्मन् a stone.

m. (-हूः)
Swallow wort.
E.
अर्क, and अक्व appellation: bearing all the synonyms of the sun.

m. (-मः)
The instant of conjunction of the sun and moon.
E.
अर्क the sun, इन्दु the moon, and सङ्गम union.

m. (-लः)
1 The sun-stone.
2 A ruby.
3 A crystal lens.
E.
अर्क, and उपल a stone.

m. (-र्किः)
A son of the sun, as SANI and the rest.
E.
अर्क the sun, and इञ् aff.

mfn. (-र्क्षः-र्क्षी-र्क्षं)
Stellar, regulated by the stars or constellations.
E.
ऋक्ष and अण् aff.

m. (-र्षः)
A stellar year, or revolution of a constellation.
E.
आर्क्ष and बर्ष a year.
